ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Content.helper: Enter the formatted content for content. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

ButtonText.helper: Enter the button text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ButtonIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

ButtonUrl.helper: Enter the web address for button web addresses. You can use a page on this site or another website.

ButtonTarget.helper: Choose the button target from the available options.

Animation.helper: If specified, how do you want the element to appear when it appears to the visitor? Don't use if also turning on animations in the template settings.

Items.helper: Add and arrange the items used for items. Remove any item you do not need.
